properties.statement:
ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on main c58305ba8 and the live design, 2026-10-13; RUN AS THE SKILL, root-cause fetched fresh).

1 OBSERVED: 264 ANTICIPATES edges. 157 are suppressed as parked and 60 as resolved, leaving 47 raised (live detect_defects agrees on 157 and 60). Of the 47:
- 5 point at an accepted requirement already delivered by derivation (a realized or verified capability SATISFIES it);
- 13 point at a finding that was acted on another way (INVALIDATES from a ChangeEvent, MITIGATES from an accepted Decision, CAUSES or TRIGGERS into a decision, change or requirement, or a valid_to);
- 2 point at a ChangeEvent or a DesignRule;
- 18 point at a finding that nothing acts on;
- 9 are other: 5 undelivered requirements, 2 superseded decisions, 1 deferred decision, 1 planned capability.
Expected: a setup that was acted on is not reported. NOT affected: Decision targets (accepted counts), Capability targets and epochs.

2 PRECEDENT: fact:unresolved-setup-says-nothing-follows-through-and-never-checks-whether-anything-did (2026-09-02), fixed by chg:two-repair-rules-compute-the-condition-their-message-names under dec:a-rule-computes-the-condition-its-message-names (accepted 2026-09-15 on the owner's word).

3 CAUSE: follow_through_exists (heal.rs) implements that decision's list. A Requirement arrives only at `met`, and a type with no status (TemporalFact, ChangeEvent, DesignRule) arrives only by EVOLVES_INTO. Three of those readings disagree with the rest of the design:
(a) `met` is never set: 0 of 385 requirements carry it, and report.rs (BL-104) says delivery is derived from the thread because a hand-set "done" outlives the truth.
(b) This design closes a finding with INVALIDATES from a ChangeEvent (205 such edges) or MITIGATES, not with EVOLVES_INTO.
(c) detect_decision_overtaken_by_promotion (detect.rs) counts a ChangeEvent or DesignRule target as taken up by its existence; follow_through_exists does not.
Readings (a) to (c) make 20 of the 47. With the 9 mislabelled contradictions (fact:root-cause-review-relations-cannot-mark-a-contradiction-supporting-and-the-default-says-opposing-2026-10-13), the engine makes 29 defects, not the 44 the 2026-10-13 judgement pass reported.

4 UNSEPARATED: the 18 finding-to-finding edges where nothing acts on the later finding. The schema reads ANTICIPATES as before(x,y) and about(x,y), with no obligation, and their evidence reads as precedent ("the 2026-08-24 finding named the class; this is the same shape recurring"). Whether the later finding owes a follow-through is a meaning question under the 09-15 decision, and no measurement separates it.

5 CLASS: "arrived" is re-derived by hand in each detector, and the copies disagree. heal.rs's own comment on is_parked_idea describes the same shape for parked ideas, one incident at a time.
